_comment: Scale-existence battery, oracle tier (positive control - a scale certainly exists). 8 self-contained arithmetic claims with graded relative error from exact to absurd; truth = 1/(1+|stated-true|/|true|), computed mechanically. Items descending by truth. Harmonic block: four claims across DIFFERENT operations (multiplication, addition, division, percentage) all at ~2 percent relative error - closely matched, genuinely hard to rank.

attribute.primary: how accurate the arithmetic claim is: how close its stated result is to the true value
attribute.opposite: how inaccurate the arithmetic claim is: how far its stated result is from the true value
paraphrases: the numerical correctness of its stated result
how nearly the asserted answer matches the actual computation
the closeness of its claimed value to the true one
